LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.description: A foreign flame fastened to the target's life. It drains needs and age, weakens combat and work, deals true burning damage, and spills part of itself to nearby enemies when the host dies.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_LifeBurn.stages.0.label: <color=#FF7A45>Life Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.description: Mingyuan turns the burning inside herself into momentum. Stored layers can rise above the bonus limit as a buffer, but damage, movement, attack speed, work speed, shield regeneration, and Life Burn bonuses only count up to 300 effective layers.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_SelfBurn.stages.0.label: <color=#FFB25C>Self Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.description: A body remade by pale extradimensional fire. Body parts become vastly harder to break, consciousness rises, heat and explosions are converted into recovery, attackers are burned in return, control states are cleared, and brief invulnerability follows real wounds.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_BurningBody.stages.0.label: <color=#FFD37A>Burning Body</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.label: <color=#FFE0A3>Protective Flame Shield</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_ProtectiveFlameShield.descri: A 200-energy pale flame shield. It absorbs very small hits, overwhelming hits, and lethal strikes, spends 10 energy per absorbed hit, batches regeneration every 10 seconds, rebuilds after breaking, and clears hostile control when struck. At 300 effective Self Burn layers, absorbed hits cost no energy and add more Self Burn.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.label: <color=#FF5C3A>Rebirth Flame</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_RebirthFlame.description: When Mingyuan falls, the flame buried in her body detonates and begins shaping her back from the ashes.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.label: <color=#FF2E1F>Eternal Burning</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_EternalBurning.description: Mingyuan is enclosed in the fire that rebuilds her. While this flame lasts, outside blows cannot decide her death.
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.label: <color=#C95CFF>Time Burn</color>
LanguageData.MX_Mingyuan_TimeBurnFrozen.description: The target's lifetime is being burned away. When the remaining biological age reaches zero, the flame claims the body.
